scenes.name: WILL IT DECAY
lines: Will the proton decay? In grand unification, quarks and leptons share one multiplet.
质子会不会衰变？在大统一里，夸克与轻子同处一个多重态。
So three quark doublets and a lepton doublet can meet at a single point: the operator QQQL.
于是三个夸克双重态与一个轻子双重态可以在同一点相遇：这就是算符 QQQL。
Its hypercharge, three sixths minus a half, is zero: gauge invariant, yet it changes baryon number by one.
它的超荷是三个六分之一减二分之一，恰为零：规范不变，却让重子数改变一。

scenes.name: THIRTY-SIX TERMS
lines: Maybe three identical quarks cancel by Pauli exclusion?
也许三个同代夸克会被泡利不相容消掉？
Expand it: twelve quark components, four lepton components.
那就逐项展开：夸克有十二个分量，轻子有四个。
Exactly thirty-six distinct monomials survive. This one has coefficient four.
恰好有三十六个互异单项留下来；这一项的系数是四。
So the same low-energy data allow any coefficient c6.
所以同一套低能数据，可以配上任意的系数 c6。

scenes.name: NO LOCAL WALL
lines: Can local flatness forbid it? Lean checks, with zero axioms: a closed two-cochain is exact.
局域平坦能不能禁止它？Lean 内核在零公理下检验：闭的二上链一定正合。
The proof is a cone: e of x, y is F of base, x, y, and d e gives back F.
证明就是一个锥：令 e(x, y) 等于 F(base, x, y)，它的上边缘恰好还原 F。
Lean also checks: six Hurwitz generators split mod five into nonzero rank-one matrices.
Lean 还检验：六个赫维茨生成元在模五下分裂为非零的秩一矩阵。
Neither fixes c6. Local closure builds no global wall.
这两条都管不住 c6。局域闭合砌不出全局的墙。

scenes.name: BARYON TRIALITY
lines: The proton needs a global symmetry. On neutral color singlets, the charge is minus h times B, mod three.
质子需要一条全局对称：在超荷中性的色单态上，荷是负 h 乘 B，模三。
Take h nonzero. Yukawa and Weinberg terms keep phase one; QQQL picks up a nontrivial cube root, and is forbidden.
取 h 不为零：汤川项与温伯格项相位为一，保留；QQQL 带上非平凡的三次单位根，被禁止。
Only changes of B by three survive: the first allowed operator jumps from dimension six to fifteen.
只剩 B 改变三的过程：最低允许的算符从六维跳到十五维。
With B minus L kept, eighteen. Three generations of weak instantons change B by exactly three.
若同时守恒 B 减 L，则是十八维；而三代弱瞬子恰好让 B 改变三。

scenes.name: SIX TRACES
lines: Triality can be gauged: X equals three B minus nine L tau, plus a conjugate tau neutrino.
重子三重对称可以规范化：X 等于三 B 减九 L_τ，再添一个共轭 τ 中微子。
All six anomaly traces cancel to zero.
六项反常迹逐一相消为零。
A charge nine condensate leaves Z nine; its cube is the color center, so singlets see Z three.
荷九凝聚留下 Z9；它的立方正是色中心，所以色单态看到的是 Z3。
The price: the charge must depend on the generation.
代价是：荷必须依赖世代。

scenes.name: TWENTY-FIVE STATES
lines: On a lens space, the shell's triality phase meets a cubic anomaly; the smallest extension that trivializes it is Z nine.
把球壳的三重相位放到透镜空间上，会遇到一个立方反常；能把它平凡化的最小扩张是 Z9。
To carry Z nine faithfully, the nineteen-point Behrend shell needs at least twenty-five states.
要忠实承载 Z9，十九点贝伦德球壳最少需要二十五个状态。

scenes.name: THE FORK
lines: The sharpest test: one actual Riemann zero, the joint witness, with its one hundred five winding vacuum.
最尖锐的检验是一枚实际的黎曼零点，即联合见证，以及它的一百零五圈真空。
Orthogonal auxiliary currents cancel the dimension-six vertex: triality holds, the proton is stable.
辅助电流相互正交，六维顶点相消，三重对称成立，质子稳定。
Parallel currents switch on QQQL, with Wilson factor at least zero point zero three one four.
辅助电流相互平行，QQQL 被激活，威尔逊因子至少约 0.0314。
The same vacuum allows both. Deciding c6 from the partition function is still open.
同一座真空两支都容许。从配分函数裁决 c6，仍是开放问题。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Unification, chapter nine.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第九章
